fields.value: Replication Data for: High-Resolution Nighttime Temperature and Rock Abundance Mapping of the Moon using the Diviner Lunar Radiometer Experiment with a Model for Topographic Removal

dsDescriptionValue.value: Global nighttime temperature and rock abundance maps of the Moon derived using the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) Diviner Lunar Radiometer. All maps are gridded at 128 pixels-per-degree (ppd) and span +/-180˚ longitude and +/-70˚ latitude.

publicationCitation.value: Powell, T. M., Horvath, T., Lopez Robles, V., Williams, J.-P., Hayne, P. O., Gallinger, C. L., Greenhagen, B. T., McDougall, D. S., Paige, D. A. (2022; submitted). High-Resolution Nighttime Temperature and Rock Abundance Mapping of the Moon using the Diviner Lunar Radiometer Experiment with a Model for Topographic Removal. Journal of Geophysical Research: Planets.
